jit.fx.alphaglue.name: jit.fx.alphaglue
jit.fx.alphaglue.digest: Create alpha channel from second input
jit.fx.alphaglue.description: Creates an alpha channel on input using luminance or specified plane from the second input.

jit.fx.altern.name: jit.fx.altern
jit.fx.altern.description: Overlays a color screen onto incoming textures. The original texture values are revealed through gaps in the screen.

jit.fx.an.max.name: jit.fx.an.max
jit.fx.an.max.description: Reports the maximum values for each plane of a given input texture.

jit.fx.an.mean.name: jit.fx.an.mean
jit.fx.an.mean.description: Reports the mean values for each plane of a given input texture.

jit.fx.an.min.name: jit.fx.an.min
jit.fx.an.min.description: Reports the minimum values for each plane of a given input texture.

jit.fx.bitcrush.name: jit.fx.bitcrush
jit.fx.bitcrush.description: Applies bitcrushing to an incoming texture and reduces its color depth.

jit.fx.blur.name: jit.fx.blur
jit.fx.blur.description: Blur incoming texture. Apply gaussian blur to the texture input.

jit.fx.brass.name: jit.fx.brass
jit.fx.brass.description: Provides a quick and dirty embossing effect on an input texture. You can specify the width of the emboss effect and apply an overall tint to the output texture.

jit.fx.brcosa.name: jit.fx.brcosa
jit.fx.brcosa.description: Permits you to simultaneously adjust an image's brightness, contrast and saturation. This is useful for achieving a variety of color effects.

jit.fx.bsort.name: jit.fx.bsort
jit.fx.bsort.description: Performs a bubble sort on an incoming texture, sorting pixels in ascending order

jit.fx.camera.name: jit.fx.camera
jit.fx.camera.description: Simulates a virtual camera for image panning, zooming, and rotation, with optional motion blur.

jit.fx.cf.bilateral.name: jit.fx.cf.bilateral
jit.fx.cf.bilateral.description: Applies bilateral filtering to a given input texture.

jit.fx.cf.directional.name: jit.fx.cf.directional
jit.fx.cf.directional.description: Applies directional blur to a given input texture.

jit.fx.cf.gaussian.name: jit.fx.cf.gaussian
jit.fx.cf.gaussian.description: Applies gaussian blur to a given input texture.

jit.fx.cf.kuwahara.name: jit.fx.cf.kuwahara
jit.fx.cf.kuwahara.digest: Applies a generalized anisotropic Kuwahara filter
jit.fx.cf.kuwahara.description: Applies a generalized anisotropic Kuwahara filter for edge-preserving smoothing and stylization.

jit.fx.cf.radial.name: jit.fx.cf.radial
jit.fx.cf.radial.description: Applies radial blur to a given input texture.

jit.fx.cf.sharpen.name: jit.fx.cf.sharpen
jit.fx.cf.sharpen.description: Applies a sharpening filter to a given input texture.

jit.fx.cf.tiltshift.name: jit.fx.cf.tiltshift
jit.fx.cf.tiltshift.description: Generates a tilt-shift blur effect, simulating shallow depth of field.

jit.fx.co.accum.name: jit.fx.co.accum
jit.fx.co.accum.digest: Blend and accumulate a second input
jit.fx.co.accum.description: Accumulates two inputs to create a fading effect.

jit.fx.co.additive.name: jit.fx.co.additive
jit.fx.co.additive.description: Additive effect that combines two inputs together.

jit.fx.co.brightlight.name: jit.fx.co.brightlight
jit.fx.co.brightlight.digest: Blend textures with emphasis on bright regions
jit.fx.co.brightlight.description: Creates a bright light effect by blending textures and amplifying the brightness of lighter regions in the inputs.

jit.fx.co.burn.name: jit.fx.co.burn
jit.fx.co.burn.description: Creates a burn effect that darkens the dark parts of the inputs.

jit.fx.co.chromakey.name: jit.fx.co.chromakey
jit.fx.co.chromakey.description: Chroma keying support using target colors.

jit.fx.co.darken.name: jit.fx.co.darken
jit.fx.co.darken.description: Take the minimum of each pixel for two given inputs

jit.fx.co.difference.name: jit.fx.co.difference
jit.fx.co.difference.description: Takes the difference between corresponding pixels using abs

jit.fx.co.dodge.name: jit.fx.co.dodge
jit.fx.co.dodge.description: Brightens a primary input using a secondary input

jit.fx.co.exclude.name: jit.fx.co.exclude
jit.fx.co.exclude.description: Blend a primary input with a secondary input, creating complimentary colors.

jit.fx.co.freeze.name: jit.fx.co.freeze
jit.fx.co.freeze.description: Creates a frozen effect with a second input.

jit.fx.co.glow.name: jit.fx.co.glow
jit.fx.co.glow.description: Creates a glowing effect using a second input, amplifying bright areas in the inputs.

jit.fx.co.hardlight.name: jit.fx.co.hardlight
jit.fx.co.hardlight.description: Creates a high-contrast hardlight effect using a second input.

jit.fx.co.heat.name: jit.fx.co.heat
jit.fx.co.heat.description: Creates a heat effect, intensifying cool colors using a second input.

jit.fx.co.inverse.name: jit.fx.co.inverse
jit.fx.co.inverse.description: Inverts and blends the primary input with the secondary input.

jit.fx.co.lighten.name: jit.fx.co.lighten
jit.fx.co.lighten.description: Takes the brightest element between corresponding pixels in inputs.

jit.fx.co.lumakey.name: jit.fx.co.lumakey
jit.fx.co.lumakey.description: Uses a secondary input for luminance keying support.

jit.fx.co.multiply.name: jit.fx.co.multiply
jit.fx.co.multiply.description: Multiply and blend two inputs together.

jit.fx.co.overlay.name: jit.fx.co.overlay
jit.fx.co.overlay.description: Overlays a second input onto a primary one.

jit.fx.co.reflect.name: jit.fx.co.reflect
jit.fx.co.reflect.description: Blend with emphasis on bright areas in the second input.

jit.fx.co.screen.name: jit.fx.co.screen
jit.fx.co.screen.description: Blend with a projector screen effect that emphasizes lighter areas.

jit.fx.co.softlight.name: jit.fx.co.softlight
jit.fx.co.softlight.digest: Blend textures with a subtle emphasis on bright regions
jit.fx.co.softlight.description: Creates a soft light effect by blending textures and amplifying the brightness of lighter regions in the inputs

jit.fx.co.stamp.name: jit.fx.co.stamp
jit.fx.co.stamp.description: Overlay a second image directly onto a primary image.

jit.fx.co.subtractive.name: jit.fx.co.subtractive
jit.fx.co.subtractive.description: Subtractive effect that shows the difference between inputs

jit.fx.concat.name: jit.fx.concat
jit.fx.concat.description: Accepts two texture as input, and sends a single concatenated texture out.

jit.fx.conway.name: jit.fx.conway
jit.fx.conway.description: Performs Conway's Game of Life (a cellular automata function) on incoming textures.

jit.fx.crt.name: jit.fx.crt
jit.fx.crt.description: Simulates the visual characteristics of an old CRT monitor.

jit.fx.delay.name: jit.fx.delay
jit.fx.delay.description: Delay texture input by a certain amount of frames that can be set with the delay attribute.

jit.fx.dimmap.name: jit.fx.dimmap
jit.fx.dimmap.description: Provides remapping and/or inversion of texture dimensions. Similar to the jit.transpose object, however any dimension may be mapped to any other dimension as well as inverted. Note that the input to output map may not contain any duplicates. Redundant dimensions of size 1 may be inserted by using a map value of -1 at the corresponding dimension index.

jit.fx.eclipse.name: jit.fx.eclipse
jit.fx.eclipse.description: Divides a texture sent into the left inlet into a grid with a specified number of rows and columns. Each box in the grid contains a scaled-down representation of the overall texture. Each box is then tinted so that the overall image resembles a second texture (sent into the right inlet). If the same image is used in both inputs, the result is a self-similar (or meta-) image.

jit.fx.ge.flowfield.name: jit.fx.ge.flowfield
jit.fx.ge.flowfield.description: Creates a flow field visual effect where dynamic lines are generated over an image, with their orientation influenced by the underlying color values, which they interpret as rotational vectors.

jit.fx.ge.lineinterp.name: jit.fx.ge.lineinterp
jit.fx.ge.lineinterp.description: Generates connecting lines along edges of image regions whose color values fall within a defined range.

jit.fx.ge.pattern.name: jit.fx.ge.pattern
jit.fx.ge.pattern.description: Generates Voronoi / Delaunay patterns from the input image.

jit.fx.ge.randlines.name: jit.fx.ge.randlines
jit.fx.ge.randlines.description: Creates random lines connecting pairs of pixels.

jit.fx.hue.name: jit.fx.hue
jit.fx.hue.description: Performs a hue rotation, preserving the luminance values.

jit.fx.lin2srgb.name: jit.fx.lin2srgb
jit.fx.lin2srgb.description: jit.fx.lin2srgb converts a texture in linear color space to srgb.

jit.fx.multiplex.name: jit.fx.multiplex
jit.fx.multiplex.digest: Multiplex (interleave) two textures into one texture
jit.fx.multiplex.description: The jit.multiplex object takes two textures as input, and derives a single output texture from it by interleaving the input textures across a specified dimension. Specifically, the object takes a set of scanlines across the first input texture, placing these into the output texture, then takes a set of scanlines across the second input texture, appending them to the output texture, alternating between the two input sources until their data is exhausted.

jit.fx.pixelsorting.name: jit.fx.pixelsorting
jit.fx.pixelsorting.digest: Apply real-time pixel sorting to incoming texture
jit.fx.pixelsorting.description: Apply real-time pixel sorting to incoming texture

jit.fx.repos.name: jit.fx.repos
jit.fx.repos.description: jit.fx.repos performs cell positioning on an input texture received in its left inlet using the input from a second input texture received in its right Inlet as a spatial map.

jit.fx.rgb2luma.name: jit.fx.rgb2luma
jit.fx.rgb2luma.description: jit.fx.rgb2luma converts a 4-plane char ARGB (alpha, red, green, blue) texture into a 1-plane char monochrome texture containing the luminosity of the original texture using the equation L = (.299 * R value) + (.587 * G value) + (.114 * B value).

jit.fx.rota.name: jit.fx.rota
jit.fx.rota.description: Use the jit.fx.rota object for quick 2-dimemsional scaling and rotation of textures.

jit.fx.slide.name: jit.fx.slide
jit.fx.slide.description: The jit..fx.slide object performs pixelwise temporal envelope following.

jit.fx.srgb2lin.name: jit.fx.srgb2lin
jit.fx.srgb2lin.description: jit.fx.srgb2lin converts a texture in srgb color space to linear.

jit.fx.subtexture.name: jit.fx.subtexture
jit.fx.subtexture.digest: Reference a sub-region of a texture
jit.fx.subtexture.description: Use the jit.fx.subtexture object when you want to reference a sub region of an input texture without copying data.

jit.fx.threshold.name: jit.fx.threshold
jit.fx.threshold.digest: Apply a smooth threshold effect on input texture
jit.fx.threshold.description: Apply a smooth threshold effect on input texture. It smoothly blends pixels near the threshold using a smoothness parameter, allowing for soft transitions.

jit.fx.tp.delay.name: jit.fx.tp.delay
jit.fx.tp.delay.description: Delays a texture of a certain amount of frames.

jit.fx.tp.filter.name: jit.fx.tp.filter
jit.fx.tp.filter.description: Applies temporal filtering to a texture using a two-pole, two-zero filter

jit.fx.tp.warp.name: jit.fx.tp.warp
jit.fx.tp.warp.description: Distorts the flow of time by altering the playback speed or order of frames using luminance from the second input.

jit.fx.tr.dissolve.name: jit.fx.tr.dissolve
jit.fx.tr.dissolve.description: jit.fx.tr.dissolve transitions two textures by dissolving the former to reveal the latter.

jit.fx.tr.gridwipe.name: jit.fx.tr.gridwipe
jit.fx.tr.gridwipe.description: jit.fx.tr.gridwipe transitions two textures by dissolving the first one with an animated grid mask.

jit.fx.tr.huefade.name: jit.fx.tr.huefade
jit.fx.tr.huefade.description: jit.fx.tr.huefade performs a hue based image transition from the first to the second provided texture.

jit.fx.tr.rotfade.name: jit.fx.tr.rotfade
jit.fx.tr.rotfade.description: jit.fx.tr.rotfade performs a rotation based image transition from the first to the second provided texture. Motionblur can be optionally enabled.

jit.fx.tr.shrinkwipe.name: jit.fx.tr.shrinkwipe
jit.fx.tr.shrinkwipe.description: jit.fx.tr.shrinkwipe transitions two textures by dissolving the first one with an animated grid mask.

jit.fx.tr.slide.name: jit.fx.tr.slide
jit.fx.tr.slide.description: jit.fx.tr.slide performs a slide transition from the first to the second provided texture. Motionblur can be optionally enabled.

jit.fx.tr.vignettes.name: jit.fx.tr.vignettes
jit.fx.tr.vignettes.description: jit.fx.tr.vignettes performs a vignette based transition from the first to the second provided texture.

jit.fx.tr.xfade.name: jit.fx.tr.xfade
jit.fx.tr.xfade.description: jit.fx.tr.xfade performs a traditional cross fade transition.

jit.fx.tr.zoomfade.name: jit.fx.tr.zoomfade
jit.fx.tr.zoomfade.description: jit.fx.tr.zoomfade performs a zoom and fade based transition between the input textures. Motionblur can be optionally enabled.

jit.fx.vhs.name: jit.fx.vhs
jit.fx.vhs.description: Simulates the look of VHS playback, adding analog distortion and instability.

jit.fx.wake.name: jit.fx.wake
jit.fx.wake.description: Use the jit.fx.wake object to perform video feedback with a convolution stage on textures.

jit.gl.buffer.name: jit.gl.buffer
jit.gl.buffer.digest: A buffer of mesh data on the GPU
jit.gl.buffer.description: The jit.gl.buffer object is a named reference to a buffer of data stored on the GPU. The data is rendered via jit.gl.mesh, and jit.gl.tf is used to perform transform feedback effects.

inlets.digest: messages to this 3d object and matrix input

jit.gl.environment.name: jit.gl.environment
jit.gl.environment.digest: Manage environment textures for image-based lighting (IBL)
jit.gl.environment.description: The jit.gl.environment object utilizes internal jit.gl.cubemap and jit.openexr objects for loading and uploading equirectangular exr environment maps. Once loaded the data is converted as needed and passed to requesting objects. Environments are bound to jit.gl.node sub-contexts, and only a single environment can be active in the sub-context at a time.

jit.gl.meshwarp.name: jit.gl.meshwarp
jit.gl.meshwarp.description:
The jit.gl.meshwarp object deforms visual material projected on a two-dimensional mesh.
        It can be used for video-mapping or other creative applications.

jit.gl.pbr.digest: Generate physically based rendering materials for 3D objects

outlets.digest: connect to 3d objects to set material attribute to this

jit.gl.textmult.name: jit.gl.textmult
jit.gl.textmult.description:
The jit.gl.textmult object is very similar to jit.gl.multiple, but for text. 
        It allows to treat a list of words as several jit.gl.text objects, which can be controlled through matrices.

arguments.digest: The number of inputs the object will have. The number of inputs determines the number of glparams that can be used.

jit.gl.textureset.name: jit.gl.textureset
jit.gl.textureset.digest: A set of textures for storage and resequencing
jit.gl.textureset.description: The jit.gl.textureset object keeps a set of internal textures which may be written to or read from. This may be useful for data storage and/or texture resequencing. jit.gl.textureset mimics the functionality of jit.matrixset but outputs textures instead of matrices.

arguments.digest: The number of textures in the texture set (default = 1)

jit.gl.tf.name: jit.gl.tf
jit.gl.tf.digest: Manage transform feedback on geometric meshes
jit.gl.tf.description: The jit.gl.tf object binds to a jit.gl.mesh object, takes input from jit.gl.buffer objects, and uses a shader program defined in a jit.gl.shader object to apply a transform feedback effect on the mesh geometry.

inlets.digest: messages to this 3d object and jit.gl.buffer input

outlets.digest: connect to jit.gl.mesh object to bind

jit.gradient.ui.name: jit.gradient.ui
jit.gradient.ui.description: The jit.gradient.ui object provides a handy GUI for creating and manipulating 4-plane 1-dimensional gradient matrices. Functionality is similar to the jit.gradient object.

jit.polymovie.name: jit.polymovie
jit.polymovie.description:
jit(.gl).polymovie manages multiple jit.movie instances and allows for fast file switching
        by preloading the files. Use jit.polymovie for matrix output and jit.gl.polymovie for texture output.

jit.ui.button.name: jit.ui.button
jit.ui.button.digest: An interactive button in the rendering window
jit.ui.button.description: Use the widgets to move and resize this UI object in the rendering window using the mouse.

inlets.digest: jit.ui.button: messages to this jit.ui object

jit.ui.canvas.name: jit.ui.canvas
jit.ui.canvas.digest: A canvas to render jit.ui objects
jit.ui.canvas.description:
Every jit.ui object needs the canvas attribute set to a jit.ui.canvas name. 
		There can be more than a single jit.ui.canvas per rendering context.

inlets.digest: jit.ui.canvas: messages to this jit.ui object

outlets.digest: jit.ui.canvas: texture output if output_texture enabled
jit.ui.canvas: output reserved for future functionalities

jit.ui.group.name: jit.ui.group
jit.ui.group.digest: Group other UI objects into an interactive container
jit.ui.group.description: Use jit.ui.group to organise and automatically position jit.ui objects in the rendering window.

inlets.digest: jit.ui.group: messages to this jit.ui object

jit.ui.number.name: jit.ui.number
jit.ui.number.description: Use the widgets to move and resize this UI object in the rendering window using the mouse.

inlets.digest: jit.ui.number: messages to this jit.ui object

jit.ui.slider.name: jit.ui.slider
jit.ui.slider.digest: An interactive slider in the rendering window
jit.ui.slider.description: Use the widgets to move and resize this UI object in the rendering window using the mouse.

inlets.digest: jit.ui.slider: messages to this jit.ui object

jit.ui.toggle.name: jit.ui.toggle
jit.ui.toggle.digest: An interactive toggle in the rendering window
jit.ui.toggle.description: Use the widgets to move and resize this UI object in the rendering window using the mouse.

inlets.digest: jit.ui.toggle: messages to this jit.ui object

v8.name: v8
v8.description:
jit.gl.textureinfo reports a given textures's planecount, type, and dim attributes in the form
		
		planecount  number-of-planes 		
		type  data-type 		
		dim  dimension0... dimensionN.
